scores.summary: Global disability and dependence

scores.name: Sequential Organ Failure Assessment (original SOFA)
scores.summary: Organ dysfunction
scores.version: Original SOFA (Vincent et al. 1996), as tabulated in Sepsis-3 (Singer et al. 2016)

scores.name: ABCD² Score
scores.summary: Estimates short-term stroke risk after transient ischaemic attack.

scores.name: Rapid Arterial oCclusion Evaluation Scale
scores.summary: Prehospital estimation of the likelihood of large vessel occlusion in suspected stroke.
scores.version: RACE (Pérez de la Ossa et al. 2014)

scores.name: Los Angeles Motor Scale
scores.summary: Brief prehospital stroke severity scale.

scores.name: Field Assessment Stroke Triage for Emergency Destination
scores.summary: Prehospital estimation of large vessel occlusion likelihood in suspected stroke.

scores.name: Revised Tokuhashi Score
scores.summary: Preoperative prognostic estimate for patients with metastatic spine tumours.

scores.name: Graded Prognostic Assessment (original)
scores.summary: Estimates median survival group for patients with brain metastases.
scores.version: Original GPA (Sperduto et al. 2008, RTOG database)

scores.name: MRC Muscle Power Scale
scores.summary: Records the strength of one muscle or muscle group on a six-point ordinal scale.

scores.name: MRC Sum Score
scores.summary: Summarises global limb strength from 12 standard movements, for example when assessing ICU-acquired weakness.
scores.version: MRC sum score, 12 muscle groups (Kleyweg et al. 1991)

scores.name: Deep Tendon Reflex Grade (NINDS Myotatic Reflex Scale)
scores.summary: Records the amplitude of a muscle stretch reflex on a standard five-point scale.

scores.name: Clonus
scores.summary: Records whether clonus is present at a joint and whether it is sustained.
scores.version: Descriptive examination record: absent, unsustained or sustained

scores.name: Plantar Response
scores.summary: Records the response of the great toe to stimulation of the lateral sole.
scores.version: Descriptive examination record: flexor, extensor, equivocal or no response

scores.name: Modified Ashworth Scale
scores.summary: Grades resistance to passive movement (muscle tone) at one joint.

scores.name: Modified Tardieu Scale
scores.summary: Separates the velocity-dependent (neural) component of spasticity from fixed contracture at one joint.

scores.name: House-Brackmann Facial Nerve Grading System
scores.summary: Grades overall facial nerve function, for example after vestibular schwannoma surgery or Bell palsy.
scores.version: House-Brackmann grading system, grades I–VI (House & Brackmann 1985)

scores.name: Gardner-Robertson Hearing Classification
scores.summary: Classifies hearing in the affected ear, mainly in vestibular schwannoma, using audiometry.

scores.name: Spetzler-Martin AVM Grade
scores.summary: Grades brain arteriovenous malformations by features associated with surgical risk.

scores.name: Lawton-Young Supplementary AVM Grade
scores.summary: Adds patient and AVM features to the Spetzler-Martin grade to refine surgical risk estimation.
scores.version: Lawton-Young supplementary grading scale (Lawton et al. 2010)

scores.name: Borden Classification of Dural Arteriovenous Fistulas
scores.summary: Classifies cranial and spinal dural arteriovenous fistulas by venous drainage, the main angiographic feature associated with aggressive behaviour.
scores.version: Borden classification (Borden, Wu & Shucart 1995), types I–III with subtypes a/b

scores.name: Cognard Classification of Dural Arteriovenous Fistulas
scores.summary: Classifies intracranial dural arteriovenous fistulas by venous drainage pattern, in more detail than Borden.
scores.version: Cognard revised classification (Cognard et al. 1995): I, IIa, IIb, IIa+b, III, IV, V

scores.name: Markwalder Grading Scale for Chronic Subdural Haematoma
scores.summary: Grades the clinical condition of patients with chronic subdural haematoma.

scores.name: Engel Epilepsy Surgery Outcome Classification
scores.summary: Classifies seizure outcome after epilepsy surgery.
scores.version: Engel classification (Engel et al. 1993), classes I–IV with subclasses

scores.name: ILAE Epilepsy Surgery Outcome Classification
scores.summary: Classifies seizure outcome after epilepsy surgery for each year of follow-up, using seizure days relative to baseline.
scores.version: ILAE outcome classification (Wieser et al. 2001), classes 1–6 with 1a

scores.name: TOAST Classification of Ischaemic Stroke Subtype
scores.summary: Classifies ischaemic stroke by presumed mechanism, using clinical features and investigations.

scores.name: Oxfordshire Community Stroke Project Classification (Bamford)
scores.summary: Classifies acute stroke by bedside clinical syndrome, which relates to lesion size, site and prognosis.

scores.name: CHA₂DS₂-VASc Score
scores.summary: Estimates thromboembolic stroke risk in non-valvular atrial fibrillation.

scores.name: HAS-BLED Bleeding Risk Score
scores.summary: Estimates 1-year major bleeding risk in patients with atrial fibrillation on anticoagulation.

scores.name: Modified Treatment in Cerebral Ischaemia (mTICI) Grade
scores.summary: Grades angiographic reperfusion after thrombectomy.

scores.name: ASITN/SIR Collateral Flow Grade
scores.summary: Grades angiographic collateral flow to the ischaemic territory.
scores.version: ASITN/SIR collateral flow grading (Higashida et al. 2003)

scores.name: Fazekas Scale for White Matter Hyperintensities
scores.summary: Grades the extent of white matter T2 hyperintensities.

scores.name: Intracerebral Haemorrhage Volume (ABC/2)
scores.summary: Estimates intracerebral haematoma volume on CT at the bedside.

scores.name: BAT Score for Haematoma Expansion
scores.summary: Estimates the risk of haematoma expansion from non-contrast CT and timing.

scores.name: Suzuki Angiographic Staging of Moyamoya Disease
scores.summary: Describes the angiographic stage of moyamoya disease.

scores.name: Raymond-Roy Occlusion Classification
scores.summary: Classifies the angiographic occlusion of an aneurysm after coil embolisation.

scores.name: Canadian CT Head Rule
scores.summary: Identifies adults with minor head injury in whom the rule's criteria for CT are met.
scores.version: Canadian CT Head Rule (Stiell et al. 2001)

scores.name: NEXUS Low-Risk Criteria (cervical spine)
scores.summary: Identifies blunt trauma patients at low risk of cervical spine injury.

scores.name: Canadian C-spine Rule
scores.summary: Identifies alert, stable trauma patients in whom the rule's criteria for cervical spine imaging are met.

scores.name: Subaxial Cervical Spine Injury Classification (SLIC)
scores.summary: Classifies subaxial (C3–C7) cervical spine injuries and summarises features relevant to management.

scores.name: Thoracolumbar Injury Classification and Severity Score (TLICS)
scores.summary: Classifies thoracolumbar injuries and summarises features relevant to management.

scores.name: Anderson and D'Alonzo Classification of Odontoid Fractures
scores.summary: Classifies odontoid (dens) fractures by level.

scores.name: Levine and Edwards Classification of Hangman's Fractures
scores.summary: Classifies traumatic spondylolisthesis of C2 (hangman's fracture).
scores.version: Levine and Edwards (1985), types I, II, IIa, III

scores.name: Pfirrmann Grading of Disc Degeneration
scores.summary: Grades lumbar intervertebral disc degeneration on T2-weighted MRI.

scores.name: Modic Endplate Changes
scores.summary: Classifies degenerative vertebral endplate and marrow signal changes on MRI.

scores.name: Meyerding Grading of Spondylolisthesis
scores.summary: Grades the degree of vertebral slip in spondylolisthesis.

scores.name: Schizas Grading of Lumbar Spinal Stenosis
scores.summary: Grades the morphological severity of central lumbar spinal stenosis.
scores.version: Schizas et al. (2010), grades A1–A4, B, C, D

scores.name: Koos Grading of Vestibular Schwannoma
scores.summary: Grades vestibular schwannoma extension.

scores.name: Simpson Grade of Meningioma Resection
scores.summary: Describes the extent of meningioma resection.

scores.name: Knosp Classification (modified) of Cavernous Sinus Invasion
scores.summary: Grades the likelihood of cavernous sinus invasion by pituitary adenoma.
scores.version: Knosp classification as modified by Micko et al. (2015): 0, 1, 2, 3A, 3B, 4

scores.name: Hardy Classification of Pituitary Adenomas (modified by Wilson)
scores.summary: Describes sellar destruction and extrasellar extension of pituitary adenomas.
scores.version: Hardy sellar grades 0–IV with Wilson's extrasellar stages A–E

scores.name: Lansky Play-Performance Scale
scores.summary: Describes functional performance in children with cancer.
scores.version: Lansky et al. (1987), 0–100 in steps of 10

scores.name: Status Epilepticus Severity Score
scores.summary: Estimates the risk of death in adults with status epilepticus, assessed before treatment.

scores.name: Cerebral Perfusion Pressure
scores.summary: Calculates cerebral perfusion pressure from MAP and ICP.

scores.name: Calculated Serum Osmolality and Osmolar Gap
scores.summary: Calculates serum osmolality and the osmolar gap, e.g. when monitoring mannitol therapy.

scores.name: Hoehn and Yahr Staging of Parkinson's Disease
scores.summary: Describes the stage of motor disability in Parkinson's disease.

scores.name: GBS Disability Scale (Hughes)
scores.summary: Grades functional disability in Guillain-Barré syndrome.
scores.version: GBS disability scale (Hughes 1978) as used in EGOS (van Koningsveld 2007)

scores.name: Erasmus GBS Outcome Score
scores.summary: Estimates the probability of being unable to walk independently at 6 months in Guillain-Barré syndrome.

scores.name: MGFA Clinical Classification of Myasthenia Gravis
scores.summary: Classifies the maximum severity and distribution of myasthenic weakness.

scores.name: Chiari Malformation Classification
scores.summary: Classifies hindbrain herniation malformations.

scores.name: Seddon Classification of Nerve Injury
scores.summary: Classifies peripheral nerve injury by the structures disrupted.

scores.name: Sunderland Classification of Nerve Injury
scores.summary: Grades peripheral nerve injury by the connective tissue layers disrupted.

withheld.name: Full Outline of UnResponsiveness
withheld.withheldReason: Reproductions carry 'Used with permission of Mayo Foundation… All rights reserved'; the author handles permission requests. Not reproduced until permission is confirmed.

withheld.name: Modified Graeb Score
withheld.withheldReason: Sources agree on the 0–32 total and +1 per region for expansion, but describe the scored regions and fill thresholds inconsistently; requires the Morgan 2013 primary table.

withheld.name: ASIA Impairment Scale (ISNCSCI)
withheld.withheldReason: ISNCSCI and the AIS worksheet are maintained by ASIA/ISCoS with reproduction terms and periodic revisions (current 2019 revision); requires licensing and version review.

withheld.name: Oswestry Disability Index
withheld.withheldReason: ODI version 2.1a is © Jeremy Fairbank, licensed through Mapi Research Trust; free only for unfunded academic research and individual clinical practice, with a fee for commercial use.

withheld.name: Tokuhashi Score (original 1990)
withheld.withheldReason: Original 1990 item weights verified, but the vertebral-body metastasis item has the same unresolved conflict as the revised score, and published prognosis bands for the original are inconsistent. Revised Tokuhashi (2005) is implemented separately.

withheld.name: Richmond Agitation–Sedation Scale
withheld.withheldReason: Virginia Commonwealth University lists RASS as a licensable technology; terms for use in a commercial app must be confirmed. Content is verified and ready to reinstate after licensing review.

withheld.name: Japanese Orthopaedic Association Score
withheld.withheldReason: Five substantially different versions exist (1975 original, 1994 revised, 1991/1993/1999 modifications). The 1975 item wording (including the chopsticks item) was not available in a verifiable English source. mJOA (Benzel 1991) is implemented separately.

withheld.name: Sequential Organ Failure Assessment-2 (2025)
withheld.withheldReason: SOFA-2 (Ranzani et al., JAMA 2025) has detailed sub-rules (organ-support definitions, vasopressor dose categories, alternatives when no arterial blood gas). Only a simplified adaptation was available for verification; not implemented until the full published table is checked.

withheld.name: Disease-specific Graded Prognostic Assessments
withheld.withheldReason: Disease-specific GPAs (lung, breast, melanoma, renal, GI and others) are separate instruments that are updated frequently; each needs its own verified version before implementation.

withheld.name: Sunnybrook Facial Grading System
withheld.withheldReason: Item point values could not be confirmed from an accessible primary source in this review, the stated 0–100 composite range does not match the arithmetic of the published weights, and translation groups obtained the authors' permission before adapting the form. Not implemented until the original form and its terms are checked.

withheld.name: Paediatric Glasgow Coma Scale
withheld.withheldReason: Several different paediatric modifications are in use (verbal scales for preverbal children differ), and the official Glasgow paediatric aid has its own reproduction terms. Not implemented until one version and its terms are confirmed.

withheld.name: Epidemiology-based Mortality Score in Status Epilepticus
withheld.withheldReason: Aetiology, comorbidity, age and EEG item weights could not be confirmed from an accessible primary source in this review.

withheld.name: Response Assessment in Neuro-Oncology criteria
withheld.withheldReason: RANO 2010 and RANO 2.0 (2023) differ; response categories need serial measurements and steroid/clinical data, which a single-entry calculator cannot capture reliably.

withheld.name: McDonald criteria for multiple sclerosis (2017)
withheld.withheldReason: Diagnostic criteria. The app does not diagnose; to be reconsidered as a reference checklist.

withheld.name: WHO Classification of CNS Tumours (5th ed., 2021)
withheld.withheldReason: A reference classification of tumour types and grades rather than a calculator; integrated molecular diagnosis is outside the app's scope.

withheld.name: AO Spine injury classifications
withheld.withheldReason: AO Spine classifications are published by AO Foundation with reproduction terms; not implemented until permission is confirmed. TLICS and SLIC are implemented instead.

withheld.name: Expanded Disability Status Scale (Kurtzke)
withheld.withheldReason: The scoring definitions and Neurostatus training materials have reproduction and use terms; not implemented until permission is confirmed.

withheld.name: Revised ALS Functional Rating Scale
withheld.withheldReason: A copyrighted questionnaire; use terms not confirmed.

withheld.name: Confusion Assessment Method for the ICU
withheld.withheldReason: Copyrighted instrument with its own terms of use; not reproduced until confirmed.

withheld.name: Brain death / death by neurological criteria checklist
withheld.withheldReason: Criteria and procedures are defined by national and institutional protocols; a single checklist would not be correct everywhere.
